newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-National, CBA cut some rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-National, CBA cut some rates.

text.p: National Australia Bank (NAB) and the Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) on Friday announced reductions in some fixed interest rate home loans rates as competition in the mortgage market remains fierce.
NAB announced interest rate reductions of up to 0.45 percentage points for owner occupiers and investors.

It cuts its one-year fixed rate to 7.75 percent from 7.90, its two-year rate to 8.15 percent from 8.5, its three-year to 8.15 percent from 8.60, its four year to 8.55 percent from 8.80 and its five-year to 8.65 percent from 8.90.
The CBA has cut its housing loan rates by up to 0.15 percentage points for periods from two to five years.
The CBA cut its two-year rate to 7.85 percent from 7.95, its three year rate to 8.25 percent from 8.4, its four year rate to 8.5 percent from 8.75 and its five year rate to 8.65 percent from 8.75.
